title: Cannabis sativa biochar: characterization and preliminary application in plant growth and adsorption, and as an electrode material
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,1932-1940
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00829D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maria Belen Ceretta, Sofia Antic Gorrazzi, Sebastian D’Ippolito, Julieta Mendieta, Debora Nercessian, Sebastian Bonanni
Biochar offers a sustainable use of cannabis residues. Low temperature biochar can be used for contaminant adsorption and in soil amendment, and high temperature biochar as an electrode material in electrochemical and bioelectrochemical applications.
